craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of glory in gear — hand-and-emblem song. Outside-mirrored always; trident-pretext held. Rejected: (a) mirror→copy → killed: mirror reflects. Read aloud: PA-rā-LED … AL-ways — YOU.

lines: Parā-led triple-spoked power, lovely and great —
gods You mirror outside, trident-pretext held, always — You.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ ca parādikaśaktitritayārāsundarām mahāśaktim devānukaroṣi bahis triśūladhāraṇamiṣeṇa nityaṃ tvam

reads_against.argmap: Whom imitate outside? → Triple-lovely power imitated outside by trident-pretext always.
c1_essence: Taken rest in mass; pretext commands.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of enacted glory; vīra of uprooted fears; vīra of shattered Māyā; vīra of commanded rest; nāda-vīra of heard sound; vīra of mirrored gods; vīra of borne thunderbolt; vīra of tamed world; vīra of pointed splitting; vīra of proclaimed abode
